official_sources.title: Get-ScheduledTaskInfo runtime information
official_sources.finding: Get-ScheduledTaskInfo returns last run-time information for an existing scheduled task and supports host acknowledgement based on runtime evidence rather than a request file.

official_sources.title: Get-ScheduledTask registered task state
official_sources.finding: Get-ScheduledTask returns the registered task definition and state, allowing a host to distinguish Ready, Running and missing task states without registering a new task.

official_sources.title: Start-ScheduledTask existing task activation
official_sources.finding: Start-ScheduledTask starts one or more already registered scheduled tasks; the recovery protocol remains existing-task-only and does not create a parallel runner.

official_sources.title: RegisteredTask LastRunTime evidence
official_sources.finding: RegisteredTask.LastRunTime exposes the time the task was last run, supporting comparison against the active restart request time.

official_sources.title: RegisteredTask LastTaskResult evidence
official_sources.finding: RegisteredTask.LastTaskResult exposes the result returned by the most recent run and can be recorded as independent host-side result evidence.

official_sources.title: Python os.replace atomic replacement
official_sources.finding: os.replace replaces an existing destination and provides atomic rename semantics where supported, matching the retry and acknowledgement report promotion pattern.

official_sources.title: Python stat timestamp precision caveat
official_sources.finding: st_mtime_ns is expressed in nanoseconds but underlying filesystems may provide lower precision; embedded UTC timestamps remain the primary generation evidence.

official_sources.title: Git hash-object exact blob identity
official_sources.finding: git hash-object computes the object ID for file contents; exact immutable script and manifest blob identities can be independently checked.
